customValue.label: AUV - Customer has full transaction access via Internet Banking and Phone Banking transaction
AUN - Customer has only enquiry access via Internet Banking and Phone Banking
AGE - Customer is an Agent or an Agency acting on behalf of the actual customer
ANZ - Relationship used between customer Lending Group and account
ASP - Customer is an Associate and has primary responsibility of the account
ASO - Customer is an associate of the account
TPS - Customer is an authorised signatory of the account
DBN - Customer is a beneficiary of the account and has the primary responsibility of the account
BEN - Customer is a beneficiary of the account
CCH - Customer is a credit Card holder. Depending on type of customer it could be either a personal Cardholder or a business cardholder
CON - Customer is the primary contact for this account
DLB - Customer is the primary borrower and owner of the account.
CUS - Customer is a responsible person, who has a fiduciary obligation to the beneficiary
EST - Customer is the person named in a will to carry out the wishes of a primary account after they are deceased
FID - Customer is a responsible person, who has a fiduciary obligation to the beneficiary
GTR - Customer is a guarantor of the account and carries liability on the loan
COF - Customer is the joint owner of the account and has the responsibility of the account
COO - Customer is the joint owner of the account
LOA - Customer is authorised to act on behalf and under instructions from the the person issuing the letter

LIQ - customer is the officer appointed for winding-up or liquidation and has responsibility for collecting in all of the assets of the company and settling all claims against the company before putting the company into dissolution
PTC - Customer is a participant in the account. The participation may take the form of an assignee/ assignor etc
PTF - Customer is the a partner in the partnership and has the responsibility of the account
PTO - Customer is a partner in the partnership owning the account
POA - A Customer appointed by Account Owner to conduct business on their behalf
RCV - Customer appointed by a bankruptcy court or secured creditor to run a company for a short period of time in a manner that will ensure as much debt is paid back to creditors as possible
ROS - Customer who will automatically absorb a dying owner's share of the property
IND - Customer is the Sole Owner of the account
TSF - Customer is a trustee of the account and also the owner of the account
TSM - Customer is a trustee but is a minor
TSO - Customer is a trustee of the account
SOL - Customer is sole owner of the account (All products)
BCH - The related Customer is the Card Holder on a Business card account
UNO - Customer is an unnamed owner of the account. Only used for accounts that participate in a portfolio arrangement.
BCG - The related Customer is the Billing Group Customer of the Business card account
BCC - The related Customer is the Direct Owner of the Business card account
AD1 - Customer will be secondary Cardholder on approval of the related Card application
AD2 - Customer will be secondary Cardholder on approval of the related Card application
AD3 - Customer will be secondary Cardholder on approval of the related Card application
ITF - Customer is primary trustee of the account and is not an owning investor of the account. A DBN relationship must also be related to the account. (All products except credit cards)
CLG - The relationship used between a customer lending group customer and existing accounts in CLG
PRI - Customer has primary responsibility for the account and is owner of the business name.
ITO - Customer is a trustee of the account and is not an owning investor of the account. An ITF and DBN relationship must also be related to the account. (All products except credit cards)
PAE - The related Customer is an Embosser Applicant of the Personal Card Application
PCC - The related Customer is a Direct Owner of the Personal Card Account
PCH - The related Customer is a Card Holder on a Personal Card Account
COM - AN INDIVIDUAL WHO CARRIES LIABILITY ON A LOAN.
DEP - AN INDIVIDUAL WHO MAY OPEN A SAFE DEPOSIT BOX HE DOES NOT OWN.
EXC - THE SIGNER(S) ARE THE EXECUTOR(S) OR EXECUTRIX(S) FOR AN ESTATE.
IGE - A RELATIONSHIP OF INDEMNITY GUARANTEE EXISTS
IJF - JOINT INDIVIDUALS FIRST OWNER
IJO - JOINT INDIVIDUALS OTHER OWNER
JNT - JOINT ACCOUNT USED ONLY FOR SSA ACCOUNTS
JTF - JOINT INDIVIDUAL/PARTNERSHIP ACCOUNT FIRST OWNER
JTO - JOINT INDIVIDUAL/PARTNERSHIP ACCOUNT OTHER OWNERS.
MAK - INDIVIDUAL THAT IS PRIMARY PERSON ON A LOAN.
MGR - MANAGER ACCOUNT
NIN - COMPANY/ORGANIZATION ACCOUNT NOT JOINT
ONR - OWNER OF SAFE DEPOSIT BOX.
PAA - POWER OF ATTORNEY AGENT; A PERSON APPOINTED BY THE OWNER OF AN ACCOUNT OWNED BY OTHER THAN AN INDIVIDUAL.
PUF - UNREGISTERED PARTNERSHIP FIRST OWNER
PUO - UNREGISTERED PARTNERSHIP OTHER OWNER
SOC - ACCOUNT TO CUSTOMER LINK FOR SETOFF DDA99 ACCOUNTS ONLY
SUP - REGISTERED SUPERANNUATION FUND. THIS CODE IS REQUIRED BY THE AUSTRALIAN TAXATION OFFICE TO IDENTIFY SUPERANNUATION ACCOUNTS.
TRA - TRADING NAME OF CUSTOMER
TST - TRUST ACCOUNT CONTROLLER NOT JOINT.
OTF - WHEN NO OTHER CODE APPLICABLE.
OTH - WHEN NO OTHER CODE APPLICABLE.
OTS - WHEN NO OTHER CODE APPLICABLE.
SPE - THIS IS TO BE USED NO OTHER RELATIONSHIPS APPLY. SEE THE ACCOUNT COMMENTS INDICATING THE REASON.
GRR - AN INDIVIDUAL/COMPANY/BANK THAT GUARANTEES THE PAYMENT OF A DEBT. GENERALLY USED WITH LOANS.
SIG - AN INDIVIDUAL THAT IS A SIGNOR ONLY ON AN ACCOUNT. GENERALLY USED ON BUSINESS AND ORGANIZATIONS ACCOUNTS.
PTR - ACCOUNT OWNED BY A PARTNERSHIP.
Unknown - When source value cannot be mapped to any other value in this table
